name: Password Store
author: Jonny Heggheim
description: pass, the standard unix password manager, as an Omarchy launcher: press a key, type to search your store, then copy or type a password, username or OTP code. Decryption and clipboard clearing are left to pass itself.

barWidget.description: Bar button for the Password Store search overlay; holds its settings

schema.label: Password store directory
schema.description: Leave empty to use $PASSWORD_STORE_DIR or ~/.password-store, exactly as pass does.

schema.label: Clear the clipboard after (seconds)
schema.description: Passed to pass as PASSWORD_STORE_CLIP_TIME. pass's own default is 45.

schema.label: Username field names
schema.description: Comma-separated keys, matched case-insensitively against the 'key: value' lines of an entry. Falls back to the second line of the entry.

schema.label: Allow typing into the focused window (Ctrl+Enter)
schema.description: Ctrl+Enter types the password, Ctrl+Shift+Enter the username, using wtype. Off, only the clipboard actions remain.

schema.label: Show a notification when something is copied
